onset.Description: Start of a force-target period: first SLCdata time step with a nonzero target (receivedTargetinfo column 1), as SLCdata.NSPtime minus the start time of the NSx data packet

duration.Description: Until the next SLCdata time step with a different target value

value.Description: Target value as logged by the Simulink game (SLCdata.receivedTargetinfo column 1; raw dynamometer units, not converted to force). Each block starts with one lower value, then one value (e.g. 3660) alternates with three higher values (the article's 20, 30 and 40% MVC targets); the coding is not documented in the release
